required_review: Verify every public receipt hash against source_commit.
Verify every referenced restricted file hash against the read-only evidence package.
Recompute environment, plan, batch, analysis, and report fingerprints.
Review sample retention, failure accounting, strata, bootstrap implementation, and claim gates.
Confirm CT-524 does not claim a statistically supported network-only improvement.
Confirm CT-525 interaction language remains exploratory and non-causal.
Confirm CT-526 recovery measurements do not imply a production availability SLO.
Record every finding, exception, unresolved limitation, and final decision in an attestation conforming to independent-review-attestation-v1.schema.json.
independence_rule: reviewer_identifier must differ from executor_identity and the reviewer must not have executed or altered the measured runs
